risks.risk: Gears may slip or not reach all ratios, or the brakes may be worn.
risks.proof: Clip riding the bike through every gear and braking with each lever.
risks.if_unproven: As needing a full gear and brake service.

risks.risk: Frame may be steel rather than aluminium, or cracked or bent at the joints.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame sticker, the head tube and the rear dropouts.
risks.if_unproven: As a steel frame road bike of no named brand.

risks.risk: Chain, cassette and chainrings may be rusted or worn.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the chain, cassette and chainrings in good light.

risks.risk: Wheels may be out of true or tyres worn.
risks.proof: Clip spinning each wheel past the brake pads, plus a tyre tread close-up.
risks.if_unproven: As needing wheel truing and new tyres.

risks.risk: Photo may not be the seller's own bike.
risks.proof: Fresh photo of the bike beside a handwritten note with today's date.
risks.if_unproven: Hold the deal until the live photo arrives.

proof_requests: Clip riding through every gear and braking.
Close-up of the shifters and the gear cluster to confirm the speed count.
Close-up of the frame sticker or brand lettering and the frame material.
Close-up of the chain and cassette for rust.
Fresh photo beside a handwritten note with today's date.
response.reason: The photo clearly shows an adult road bike with drop bars, which can be priced by type at its worst case; the gear count, aluminium frame and working condition are unproven and priced as not proven.
